artifact_classes.lake_platform_policy: Module setup traces use the tri-state platformIndependent policy. With none, platform-dependent library/plugin traces propagate naturally; false also forces System.Platform.target; true suppresses those platform-dependent traces. The module output mapping is marked platform-independent only when the effective option is explicitly true.
artifact_classes.portability_conclusion: Not generically established across architectures or operating systems. Lake can choose a platform-neutral build/cache identity for some modules, but the configuration is an unchecked assertion and the pinned Lean .olean implementation does not itself establish cross-architecture portability.

artifact_classes.lake_platform_policy: Packages the module trace plus Lean module artifacts, generated C, and optional bitcode; it does not package the later native object/dynamic-library facets. Output mappings mark it platform-independent only for explicit platformIndependent=true.
artifact_classes.portability_conclusion: Inherits the portability limits of its members and the correctness of the platformIndependent assertion; archive format alone does not establish cross-platform reuse.

artifact_classes.lake_platform_policy: buildO/buildLeanO add platformTrace based on System.Platform.target.
artifact_classes.portability_conclusion: Host/target platform dependent by Lake's build model; do not reuse as a cross-platform substitute.

artifact_classes.lake_platform_policy: Built from object jobs whose traces include platformTrace.
artifact_classes.portability_conclusion: Derived from platform-dependent object inputs; no generic cross-platform reuse claim.

artifact_classes.lake_platform_policy: Shared-library builders add platformTrace; filename, linker flags, and runtime search environment differ by OS.
artifact_classes.portability_conclusion: Platform/ABI dependent; platform-specific rebuild or matched artifact required.

artifact_classes.lake_platform_policy: Built from native object/library jobs and through platform-sensitive linker machinery.

policy_layers.rule: platformIndependent none/false/true controls whether platform-dependent dependency traces and/or an explicit platform trace participate in module rebuild identity.
Module .ltar output mappings are marked platform-independent only when platformIndependent.getD false is true; none is therefore classified as dependent here.
Lake cache CLI uses System.Platform.target by default and drops the platform component only for packages explicitly configured platformIndependent=true.

anneal_selected_packages.anneal_packaging: selects distinct Aeneas, Rust, Lean, leantar, and Mathlib-cache assets/hashes for x86_64-linux, aarch64-linux, x86_64-darwin, and aarch64-darwin
